claim: Let \(D=G(10,2)\) be the dodecahedral graph and \(\mathcal M(D)\) its ordinary matching complex. Then \(\widetilde H_5(\mathcal M(D);\mathbb F_2)\cong\mathbb F_2^5\), \(\widetilde H_6(\mathcal M(D);\mathbb F_2)\cong\mathbb F_2^{117}\), and \(\widetilde H_i(\mathcal M(D);\mathbb F_2)=0\) for every \(i\notin\{5,6\}\).
integrity: The finite chain complex is reconstructed from the defining graph relation and checked by a standalone exact verifier; originality is limited to the recorded literature and database searches.
limitations: The claim is restricted to reduced simplicial homology with mod-2 coefficients; no integral homology or homotopy type is claimed.
title: Mod-\(2\) homology of the dodecahedral matching complex
